entities.name: Service area list IE
entities.description: Information element that conveys service area restrictions to the UE, containing either an allowed area or non-allowed area.

entities.name: Allowed tracking areas
entities.description: List of tracking areas where the UE is permitted normal service access.

entities.name: Non-allowed tracking areas
entities.description: List of tracking areas where the UE is restricted from normal service access.

entities.name: 5GMM-REGISTERED.NORMAL-SERVICE
entities.description: UE state where normal 5GMM and 5GSM procedures are allowed.

entities.name: 5GMM-REGISTERED.NON-ALLOWED-SERVICE
entities.description: UE state where service is restricted except for specific exceptions like emergency services.

entities.name: REGISTRATION ACCEPT
entities.description: NAS message that can contain the Service area list IE.

entities.name: CONFIGURATION UPDATE COMMAND
entities.description: NAS message that can contain the Service area list IE.

entities.name: TAI in allowed tracking areas list
entities.description: Condition where current tracking area identifier is in the allowed tracking areas list.

entities.name: TAI in non-allowed tracking areas list
entities.description: Condition where current tracking area identifier is in the non-allowed tracking areas list.

relations.description: REGISTRATION ACCEPT message can contain the Service area list IE.
CONFIGURATION UPDATE COMMAND message can contain the Service area list IE.
When TAI is in allowed tracking areas list, UE enters 5GMM-REGISTERED.NORMAL-SERVICE state.
When TAI is in non-allowed tracking areas list, UE enters 5GMM-REGISTERED.NON-ALLOWED-SERVICE state.
Service area list IE with allowed area indication establishes the allowed tracking areas list.
Service area list IE with non-allowed area indication establishes the non-allowed tracking areas list.
